Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
What do you think of this one?

On the List
Cardtype: Master
0 pool
Play this card on a ready minion. If this minion is titled this card costs two additional pool. The minion with this card is considered Red List.

This would be a reliable way to make others Red List and thus would solve at least one problem of trophy-decks.
The two additional pool cost for titled is for balancing out the card. If you compare it to Trumped-up Charges (pol.act.) or Red List (the action) this card seems powerful because you can't block it or vote it down/delay it. And I think it is okay because of the background. I think it is hard to put a vampire with cainite support (title) on the Red List.
You can't make s.o. Red List AND mark him in the same turn, so that is even more balancing.
Is it too weak that way?

Baron of Frankfurt

On the List
Cardtype: Master
Requires a ready titled vampire. Choose an ally, a younger vampire with no title or a titled younger vampire with less votes (Priscus counts as 3 votes for this effect). Put this card on that minion. Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
I like the idea of these requirements:

Requires an titled vampire.
Can be removed with a +1 stealth referendum.

Then I'd skip the "two additional pool" for playing on titled vampires.

I wouldn't make it trifle though, as putting someone on the Red List doesn't feel like trifleness IMHO. The idea with an additional master phase action to put a Trophycard in play is a good one but sounds too bulky in my eyes. What about "If you play this card search for a Trophy master card in your library, hand or ashheap and put it in play."? That would be very fitting the background.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Body:
(Do not want to start personal topic, so i'll write here)
I think, the weakness of trophy decks isn't in "How i should make that weakling a Red List", but in uselessness and weakness of Red List minions. Add some boost cards for Red Lists and players will want to play with Red Lists, and the trophy decks will have chances to live.

For example,

The Line Crossed
[action]
Requires a vampire of carpacity more than 3.
+2 steath action.
Bleed at +1. Either acting minion becomes Red List and you gain 1 pool, or pay 1 pool.
-- some useful bleed with cost of becoming Red List
-- picture should be smth like: a group of titled ones gathered at emergency meeting, watching TV special report (some car chasing)

Finally, hunted
[action]
+1 stealth action.
Burn a vampire in torpor (not diablerie) and this minion becomes Red List.
-- a boost card for ally decks
-- picture should be smth like: a coffin and a mortal hunter, who is splashing petrolium around it

Plan "B"
[action]
Requires tapped Red List minion.
+2 stealth action.
Untap this minion if this action successful.
-- some boost for multiaction
-- picture should be smth like: someone is jumping through a window on a car top, and shadows of chasers are visible in that window

Mad Trick
[action modifier]
Requires Red List minion.
+1 Stealth.
Blocking minion takes 1 damage or -1 intercept.
-- picture should be smth like: car flying from a ramp, the driver leaned out the window and shoots backwards with a gun.

Booby Trap
[combat]
Usable once per action, before range is determined. Requires a Red List minion.
Opposing minion takes 2 damage, or his controller may discard 2 combat cards to cancel this card as it played.
-- picture should be smth like: a forest, a hunter with a weapon makes threatening pose, the Red List is some steps away, unarmed and smiling. Behind the hunter is a tree with a bomb on it.

Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
Very interesting cards indeed. I like the push for Red List minions.

But still with a Trophydeck you have to make sure that red list minions are around, preferable at your prey or predator. So you have to pack cards that make other minions red list, even if there are cards around, which are attractive to use for red list minions. You can't just hope for someone playing red list.

Baron of Frankfurt
